say:0:1460473001:1.text: From what you've seen in the kids, the root of the illness seems to lie in a tug-of-war between longing for the surface and clinging to life underground.
say:0:1460473001:1.source_cn: 根据孩子们的情况，你知道，这次的病因在于对地面上的向往...

say:1:1460473002:1.text: Some people have thrown themselves into wild fantasies, convinced they're heroes or adventurers out to perform miracles.
say:1:1460473002:1.source_cn: 一部分人对地面上的冒险寄托了不切实际的幻想，认为自己是...

say:2:1460473003:1.text: Others have gone the opposite way, retreating underground, hiding in their homes, and shutting out the world entirely.
say:2:1460473003:1.source_cn: 而另一部分人则更加想要居住在地底，甚至藏在家中闭门不出...

say:3:1460473004:1.text: You decide to use what's available in the garden to prepare a recipe for them.
say:3:1460473004:1.source_cn: 你决定，从苗圃里现有的药材中挑选适合的来制作药剂。

say:4:1460473005:1.text: First off, no matter the treatment, you'll need the <style="highlight">etching iris</style> Xera brought back. That herb represents that longing for freedom, which is always something good to have.
say:4:1460473005:1.source_cn: 首先，两种药剂都少不了的，就是这次席蕾带来的<styl...

say:5:1460473006:1.text: For the adventure-happy dreamers, toss in some <style="highlight">wolf tails</style> and <style="highlight">rot sludge</style> to help them stay grounded.
say:5:1460473006:1.source_cn: 对于渴望冒险的患者，你需要一些<style=highl...

say:6:1460473007:1.text: For the anxious shut-ins, you'll need some <style="highlight">parasol mushrooms</style> and <style="highlight">flamefern</style>—something to rekindle their curiosity and help them feel joy again.
say:6:1460473007:1.source_cn: 而那些对外界恐慌的患者，你则需要<style=high...

narration:7:1460473008:0.text: You've learned the recipes for the <style="highlight">Adventurer's Potion</style> and <style="highlight">Dream Potion</style>!
